source.note: This report describes the cited UCNS state plus the current repo-owned research plan. Report-only commits are coordination metadata and are not treated as UCNS mathematical evidence. The current lexical architecture selects the xkcd constrained-English 1,000-word vocabulary as the lexical-floor candidate and OEWN 2025 Core as the primary contemporary lexical-semantic corpus; Scrabble is superseded for this work and Webster 1913 is deferred. Relationships enter gonols, completed gonols are atomic at the next scale, affixiation is scale-invariant, and direct interscale coupling is permitted without mandatory reopening of intermediate closures.

status.current_claim: UCNS currently supports bounded candidate-scoped, option-preserving multimodal relation representation while preserving unresolved construction choices explicitly. For the active lexical program, the xkcd constrained-English 1,000-word vocabulary is the lexical-floor candidate and OEWN 2025 Core is the primary contemporary lexical-semantic corpus. The operative sequence is characters -> morphology -> definitions -> recursive gonol relations. Relationships enter gonols; once constructed, a word or definition gonol is atomic at the next scale; affixiation names the scale-invariant coupling/closure pattern, not merely prefix/suffix morphology; and direct coupling across non-adjacent scales is permitted without requiring intermediate closures to be reopened. The morphology decomposition law remains unresolved. The intended PTCNA remains downstream of a not-yet-performed UCNS audit of a functioning conventional neural network.
status.current_definition: UCNS is option-preserving multimodal geometric relation-carrier research. A UCNS representation preserves relations among heterogeneous objects without requiring those objects to become numerically identical, modality-identical, or topologically identical; completion remains relative to a declared construction boundary.
